rules_version: smoke-rules-v2 (2026-08-23, DEV only; min-id per slot unless the role declares SMOKE_ORDER / SMOKE_DIVERSITY)

cases.why: a zero: the grader must be able to withhold all credit, not just award it
partial credit: the hardest judgement — some rubric credit, not all
full credit: a correct answer must not be marked down

_policy: Pre-registered DEV smoke subset for the first live execution of a candidate. Frozen before any new model output; never modified or optimized after results. Model-visible inputs are still ONLY the manifest's inputs for these case ids.
